title: Rescaled integrals over a fixed ball at a point of vanishing averages
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, h : ℝ^n → ℝ an arbitrary function, b ∈ ℝ^n and R > 0. If the averages ⨍_{B̄_s(b)} h dλ tend to 0 as s → 0⁺, then ∫_{B̄_R(0)} h(b + rc) dλ(c) → 0 as r → 0⁺. Here λ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n, and the integrals and averages are Bochner integrals.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ⨍ a in closedBall b s, h a ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ c in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, h (b + r • c) ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
